work.description: Justin Martyr's apology addressed to Antoninus Pius and associated imperial and senatorial readers, conventionally divided into sixty-eight chapters. Edition records distinguish historical translations and editorial matter; the debated literary relation between the conventionally named First and Second Apologies is not resolved by this work identity.
